transcript:
Speaker A: Can you please pronounce these words?
Speaker B: Chachi?
Speaker A: Oh god, it's not chachi, it's cache. What about this one?
Speaker B: Hipocrisy?
Speaker A: Oh god, it's not hipocrisy, it's hypocrisy. What about this one?
Speaker B: Niche?
Speaker A: Oh god, it's not niche, it's niche. What about this?
Speaker B: Asli?
Speaker A: It's not asli, it's aisle.
Speaker C: रोज बस 10 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करोगे और फर्क खुद महसूस होगा। आज ही डाउनलोड करो PW Talk ऐप और अपनी इंग्लिश को बनाओ फ्लूएंट। [If you practice for just 10 minutes daily, you will feel the difference yourself. Download the PW Talk app today and make your English fluent.]

summary: A woman corrects a man's incorrect pronunciation of common English words in a classroom setting. The ad then introduces the PW Talk app, claiming that just 10 minutes of daily practice can make users fluent. The final call to action prompts viewers to download the app on Google Play.
